changes: 🗑️ Group Chat: admin can now clear the entire chat (trash icon in the header) — needed a new Firebase rule since bulk-deleting the whole collection wasn't covered by the existing per-message rule.

⌨️ Typing indicator — shows who's currently typing. Honest caveat: this app polls Group Chat every 5s rather than using a real-time listener, so it's laggy by design (~5s to appear/clear), not instant-messaging-precise.
💬 Avatars now sit beside each message bubble (standard chat-app layout) instead of inline inside the text — clearer at a glance who's saying what.
🎨 Mode toggle rebuilt as a full-width tab-underline style instead of the old small pill pair — reads more clearly as two views of one thing.
✨ New messages now animate in with a subtle fade/rise instead of appearing instantly.
